en: The postcard features a colored image of a grand villa with ornate architectural details, statues, and decorative elements. Several people in period clothing are visible in the courtyard. The building has a symmetrical façade, a balcony over the main entrance, and statuary along the entrance and roof. The text on the postcard includes a printed greeting in Italian, handwritten notes, and a printed label identifying the villa.
